title: Cleaning a shower screen safely
learningOutcomes: Clean a shower screen without scratching the glass.

instruction.heading: Cleaning the shower screen
instruction.body:
Clean the shower screen with a neutral detergent and a soft microfibre cloth. Work from the top down so that drips run over clean glass.
Rinse the glass with clean water and dry it with a squeegee to stop water marks.
Do not use abrasive pads, because they scratch the glass and leave a dull finish.

instruction.heading: Safety first
instruction.body: Wear gloves when you use any cleaning product. Ventilate the room and never mix two cleaning products together.

procedure: Gather the detergent, cloth and squeegee.
Clean from the top down, then rinse and dry.
